channel.title: Daily Recap — 📟Tech News
channel.description: What happened in 📟Tech News, recapped daily from subscribed feeds.

item.title: Ledger wallet tampering suspected after reports of crypto thefts
item.description:
The Verge reports suspected tampering with Ledger hardware wallets following a string of crypto thefts — a worrying development for cold-storage holders.

Sources:

  • Ledger wallet tampering suspected after reports of crypto thefts

item.title: Anthropic cuts internal evals off from the internet; can AI agents keep their privacy promises?
item.description:
The Verge reports Anthropic is disconnecting its internal model evaluations from the internet, and separately examines whether AI agent makers' privacy promises will hold up under scrutiny.

Sources:

  • Anthropic is cutting off its internal evaluations from the internet
  • AI agent makers are promising privacy — will they deliver?

item.title: Reviews: LG's RGB LED TV and the tiny Telo MT1 electric truck
item.description:
The Verge reviews LG's RGB LED TV — good in certain situations, but OLED is still better — and the Telo MT1, describing it as a big truck trapped in a tiny truck's body.

Sources:

  • LG's RGB LED TV is good for certain situations, but an OLED is better
  • The Telo MT1 is a big truck trapped in a tiny truck's body

item.title: Culture reads: the techlash goes Hollywood, plus Sunmi, Fjord, and an AI bird feeder
item.description:
The Verge's lighter side today: how the techlash arrived in Hollywood, a Warner Bros–Skydance podcast deep dive, K-pop star Sunmi on Notion and ear-cleaning videos, the Fjord director on moderating risk, and one writer's brief romance with an AI bird feeder.
